name: 48 Stunden Neukölln
description: Berlin's hippest district celebrates its fascination for the arts with 48 action-packed hours of artistic endeavors. From street art to murals, conferences, markets and parties, this bottom-up, citizen-led initiative shows how much culture means to the Berliner identity. This year's theme explores borders between 'outside' and 'inside'—the blurring between the two.
